description: Sets the COMPLETE list of security groups on one of your machines: groups you list are added, groups you leave out are removed, and the result is read back from the machine. Ask the user first when it removes a group. Give groups by name or id (list_security_groups). Keep at least one. When a machine gets a public URL, the platform opens that port to any address in every security group the machine has at that moment, and closes it when the URL is removed. A group attached later does not have it. So keep a group that has the machine's public port, or add that rule to the new group first.

instance_id.description: The machine: an id from list_instances.

security_groups.description: The machine's whole list after the change, by name or id, e.g. ["default", "web-public"]. A group left out is removed from the machine.

name: set_instance_security_groups
title: Set a machine's security groups
